stop_conditions: 30 minute or three attempt case budget exhausted
active owner conflict or uncertain operation
execution.notification: Progress and final results in invoking chat

authority.source: Current scoped user invocation; saved configuration grants no permission.
allowed: Inspect selected accessible targets and make necessary reversible repairs within current authority.
escalate: Unknown ownership, uncertain effects, missing access or verification
external_actions: Require current explicit authority for messaging, installation, publication and scheduling.

retention.durable: Retain run reviews, diagnosis outputs, source hashes and evidence until explicit supersession/deletion policy; no automatic cleanup.
